summary: Iteration 2 full-stack test of Socotra Explorer. Backend: 49/49 pytest tests pass — all four new feature groups (Orders/Checkout, Verified Reviews, Photo Reviews + Upload, Admin CRUD & Booking status) plus regression suites (auth, content, favorites, bookings, reviews, notifications, admin) are green. Frontend (mobile web, 390x844, Arabic RTL): visitor login → marketplace grid loads (8 product cards) → tap product → 'أضف إلى السلة' increments cart badge (2) → cart page shows line item, qty stepper works, delivery form (cart-name/phone/address) accepts input, checkout-button succeeds, cart clears, order appears in Account → طلباتي as order-<id> with the correct $90 total for 2×$45. Verified badge: trip review by a user who has a booking shows verified-<id>; destination review has verified=false. Admin: admin login shows menu-admin, dashboard renders 6 stat cards, إدارة الحجوزات lists 11 bookings with confirm/cancel and one successful confirm; إدارة المحتوى lists 12 destinations with edit/delete/add-item. Regular user does NOT see menu-admin. Photo upload verified via /api/upload + /api/files public GET (pytest). Only pre-existing RN-Web console warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents).

issues: Legacy RN-Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: normalize GET /api/reviews to always include verified/photos fields on legacy documents (older reviews from iteration 1 lack these keys). Client currently tolerates missing fields, but a $set migration or projection default would be cleaner.
Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated RN style props (shadow*, pointerEvents) to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Orders endpoint validates empty cart (400), unknown product (404), and recomputes totals server-side — good.
Reviews verified flag is computed server-side by looking up an existing booking for (user_id, item_id) — cannot be spoofed by client.
Admin endpoints all gated by require_admin dependency; non-admin correctly gets 403 (confirmed by 3 dedicated tests).
Upload endpoint enforces auth + 8MB cap; served /api/files/{path} is intentionally public (200 without auth) and includes long Cache-Control — matches product intent.
MongoDB _id excluded from every response via {'_id': 0} projection.
Admin PUT /admin/bookings/{id}/status validates status is one of pending/confirmed/cancelled (400 otherwise) and creates a notification tied to the booking owner.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (added TestOrders, TestVerifiedReviews, TestUploads, TestAdminAdvanced — 16 new tests)

New frontend testIDs: marketplace-cart, add-to-cart, product-card-<id>, cart-plus-<id>, cart-minus-<id>, cart-remove-<id>, cart-name/phone/address/notes, checkout-button, menu-orders, order-<id>, menu-admin, stat-<key>, admin-manage-bookings, admin-booking-<id>, confirm-<id>, cancel-<id>, admin-manage-content, admin-tab-<entity>, admin-item-<id>, edit-<id>, delete-<id>, admin-add-item, field-<k>, upload-cover, admin-save, verified-<review_id>, add-review-button, add-photo-button, submit-review. expo-image-picker on web opens native file dialog which Playwright cannot complete — photo attachment verified via backend /upload + /files instead.
